## 🌟 ᴀʙᴏᴜᴛ

**ɴᴏʙɪᴛᴀ 𝗫 ᴘʀɪᴍᴇ ᴍᴜsɪᴄ ʙᴏᴛ** is a next-generation Telegram Music Bot built for speed, beauty, and reliability.

Enjoy lag-free playback, premium buttons, crystal-clear audio, beautiful thumbnails, autoplay, channel streaming, and powerful group management features.

> ✦ ᴘᴏᴡᴇʀᴇᴅ ʙʏ » [@II_NOBITA_X_PRIME_II](https://t.me/II_NOBITA_X_PRIME_II)

---

## ✨ ғᴇᴀᴛᴜʀᴇs

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 🎵 **Music Streaming** | Play any song from YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud |
| 🎞 **Video Streaming** | Full HD video streaming in voice chats |
| 📻 **Live Stream** | Stream live radio & live URLs |
| 📋 **Queue System** | Multi-track queuing with skip, pause, resume |
| 🔁 **Autoplay** | Auto-queues related songs when playlist ends |
| 📡 **Channel Play** | Stream music directly into Telegram channels |
| 🔊 **Audio Effects** | Bass boost, reverb, nightcore, and more |
| 🖼 **Thumbnails** | Dynamic play card with watermark & fallback image |
| 👑 **Admin Controls** | Full group admin management |
| 🌐 **Multi-language** | Support for multiple languages |
| 💰 **Crypto Tools** | Live TON/USDT price, wallet balance |
| 💸 **UPI Tools** | Save UPI ID, generate payment QR |
| 📊 **Bot Stats** | Live uptime, CPU, RAM, storage stats |
| 🧹 **CleanMongo** | Clean junk DB data + auto alert when storage near full |

## 🎵 ᴍᴜsɪᴄ ᴄᴏᴍᴍᴀɴᴅs

```
/play     — Play audio from YouTube / by name
/vplay    — Play video in voice chat
/cplay    — Play in linked channel voice chat
/stream   — Stream from a live URL
/pause    — Pause current track
/resume   — Resume paused track
/skip     — Skip to next track
/stop     — Stop streaming & clear queue
/queue    — View current queue
/shuffle  — Shuffle the queue
/loop     — Loop current track / full queue
/volume   — Adjust volume (1–200)
/seek     — Seek to a position in track
/end      — End voice chat
/cleanmongo — Clean junk database data (sudo only)
```

## 🚀 ᴅᴇᴘʟᴏʏ ᴏɴ ʀᴀɪʟᴡᴀʏ

### Step 1 — Fork the repo

Fork this repo to your GitHub account.

### Step 2 — Create a new Railway project

Go to [railway.app](https://railway.app) → **New Project** → **Deploy from GitHub repo** → select your fork.

### Step 3 — Set the Start Command

In Railway → Service → Settings → **Start Command**:
```
python3 -m SHUKLAMUSIC
```

### Step 4 — Add all Variables

Go to your Railway service → **Variables** tab → add every variable from the table below.

---

## 🔑 ᴀʟʟ ᴇɴᴠɪʀᴏɴᴍᴇɴᴛ ᴠᴀʀɪᴀʙʟᴇs

### 🔴 Required — Bot will NOT start without these

| Variable | Description | How to get |
|---|---|---|
| `BOT_TOKEN` | Telegram bot token | [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) → `/newbot` |
| `MONGO_DB_URI` | MongoDB connection string | [mongodb.com/atlas](https://cloud.mongodb.com) → free cluster → Connect → Driver → copy URI |
| `STRING_SESSION` | Pyrogram session string for assistant userbot | Run `python3 -c "from pyrogram import Client; import asyncio; asyncio.run(Client(':memory:', api_id=YOUR_ID, api_hash='YOUR_HASH').start())"` or use [@StringFatherBot](https://t.me/StringFatherBot) |
| `OWNER_ID` | Your Telegram numeric user ID | Send `/id` to [@userinfobot](https://t.me/userinfobot) |
| `LOGGER_ID` | Numeric ID of your log group/channel | Add bot as admin to a group, send a message, use [@getidsbot](https://t.me/getidsbot) |

---

### 🟡 Strongly Recommended — Set these to your own values

| Variable | Default value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `API_ID` | _(set in Railway)_ | Telegram API ID from [my.telegram.org](https://my.telegram.org) → App info |
| `API_HASH` | _(set in Railway)_ | Telegram API Hash from [my.telegram.org](https://my.telegram.org) |
| `LOG_GROUP_ID` | same as `LOGGER_ID` | Log group ID (can be same as `LOGGER_ID`) |
| `OWNER_USERNAME` | `II_NOBITA_X_PRIME_II` | Your Telegram username (without @) |
| `BOT_USERNAME` | `RADHA_MUSIC_GMS_op_bot` | Your bot's username (without @) |
| `BOT_NAME` | `NOBITA X PRIME` | Display name for your bot |
| `UPSTREAM_REPO` | `https://github.com/dhruvkumarray3-eng/DHRUV_X_RADHA` | Your GitHub repo URL |
| `UPSTREAM_BRANCH` | `main` | Branch to pull updates from |
| `GIT_TOKEN` | _(none)_ | GitHub personal access token (for `/update` command) — generate at [github.com/settings/tokens](https://github.com/settings/tokens) |
| `SUPPORT_CHANNEL` | `https://t.me/fragmentiic` | Your support/update channel link |
| `SUPPORT_CHAT` | `https://t.me/fragmentiic` | Your support group link |

---

### 🟢 Optional — Multiple Assistants (for high-traffic bots)

You can add up to **6 extra userbot assistants** to handle more simultaneous calls.

| Variable | Description |

| `STRING_SESSION2` | Pyrogram session for 2nd assistant userbot |
| `STRING_SESSION3` | Pyrogram session for 3rd assistant userbot |
| `STRING_SESSION4` | Pyrogram session for 4th assistant userbot |
| `STRING_SESSION5` | Pyrogram session for 5th assistant userbot |
| `STRING_SESSION6` | Pyrogram session for 6th assistant userbot |
| `STRING_SESSION7` | Pyrogram session for 7th assistant userbot |

---

### 🎵 Optional — Spotify Integration

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID` | _(empty)_ | Spotify app client ID from [developer.spotify.com](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard) |
| `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET` | _(empty)_ | Spotify app client secret |

---

### ⚙️ Optional — Limits & Behaviour

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DURATION_LIMIT` | `17000` | Max song duration in minutes (17000 = no limit) |
| `SERVER_PLAYLIST_LIMIT` | `3000` | Max tracks fetched from a playlist |
| `PLAYLIST_FETCH_LIMIT` | `25` | Tracks shown per playlist page |
| `SONG_DOWNLOAD_DURATION` | `9999999` | Max duration (seconds) allowed for download |
| `AUTO_LEAVING_ASSISTANT` | `True` | Auto-leave VC when no one is listening (`True`/`False`) |
| `ASSISTANT_LEAVE_TIME` | `9000` | Seconds before assistant auto-leaves empty VC |
| `TG_AUDIO_FILESIZE_LIMIT` | `5242880000` | Max Telegram audio file size (bytes, default 5 GB) |
| `TG_VIDEO_FILESIZE_LIMIT` | `5242880000` | Max Telegram video file size (bytes, default 5 GB) |

| `STREAM_IMG_URL` | Now-playing card for index/URL streams |

| `YOUTUBE_IMG_URL` | Fallback thumbnail when YouTube thumb unavailable |
| `SPOTIFY_ARTIST_IMG_URL` | Spotify artist info card |
| `SPOTIFY_ALBUM_IMG_URL` | Spotify album info card |
| `SPOTIFY_PLAYLIST_IMG_URL` | Spotify playlist info card |
| `PING_VIDEO_URL` | Video used in `/ping` animation |
| `SHASHANK_IMG` | Watermark base image on thumbnails |

## 📱 ᴍɪɴɪ ᴀᴘᴘ / ᴡᴇʙᴀᴘᴘ

> **No mini app is required.** The old WebApp button has been removed from the bot. The `/start` menu uses regular Telegram buttons only — no external URL, no WebApp link, no extra setup needed.

---

## 🔑 ᴍɪɴɪᴍᴜᴍ ʀᴀɪʟᴡᴀʏ sᴇᴛᴜᴘ (5 ᴠᴀʀɪᴀʙʟᴇs)

Just these 5 are enough to get the bot running:

```
BOT_TOKEN       = your_bot_token_here
MONGO_DB_URI    = mongodb+srv://user:pass@cluster.mongodb.net/dbname
STRING_SESSION  = your_pyrogram_string_session
OWNER_ID        = 123456789
LOGGER_ID       = -100123456789
```

Everything else has a working default.

---

## 🔧 ʜᴏᴡ ᴛᴏ ɢᴇᴛ sᴛʀɪɴɢ sᴇssɪᴏɴ

**Option 1 — Use a bot:**
Send `/start` to [@StringFatherBot](https://t.me/StringFatherBot) — enter your phone, API ID, API hash → copy the session string.

**Option 2 — Run locally:**
```python
# Install: pip install pyrogram TgCrypto
from pyrogram import Client
app = Client(":memory:", api_id=YOUR_API_ID, api_hash="YOUR_API_HASH")
app.run(app.export_session_string())
```
